items.prompt: After confirming a positive meeting time, why compare abs(distance)<=t*abs(closing)?

options.text: It compares the horizon exactly using integer cross products.
options.why: The positive magnitudes let the test avoid rounded division and sign reversal errors.

options.text: It approximates the ratio by rounding to the nearest integer time.
options.why: No time rounding is performed by this product comparison.

options.text: It makes every pair meet at an integer time.
options.why: Meeting times may be rational; the inequality still handles them exactly.

options.text: It changes a strict past meeting into a future one.
options.why: The separate sign test must already have established positive time.
